abstract: Maintains polar protocol zero-discharge waste processing and environmental permit certifications
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance inspector (ENV). The Environmental compliance inspector (ENV) oversees environmental audits and protocol verifications for Arctic research facilities, focusing on waste management certifications and habitat greywater recycling efficiencies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains polar protocol zero-discharge waste processing and environmental permit certifications（ECOPOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOPOL-C09：For the Vestisen Ice Dome Station, the polar treaty environmental compliance audit evaluating the complete waste management cycle indicates that zero-discharge environmental sanitation certification is false, failing closed-loop greywater packaging and total containment incinolet verification.
ENV-ECOPOL-7XA：For the Kallio Glacier Outpost, the polar treaty environmental compliance audit covering the complete waste management cycle confirms that zero-discharge environmental sanitation certification is true, with verified closed-loop greywater packaging and total containment incinolet systems.
ENV-ECOPOL-DVA：For the Svalbard Foreland Camp, the polar treaty environmental compliance audit across the complete waste management cycle confirms that zero-discharge environmental sanitation certification is true, meeting all closed-loop greywater packaging and total containment incinolet criteria.

information_points.title: Greywater recycling（GREY）
information_points.content:
ENV-GREY-UE1：For the Svalbard Foreland Camp, the hydrological filtration audit of the habitat plumbing circuit measures a greywater recycling efficiency of 70 %, representing the proportion of domestic wash water reclaimed for camp operations.
ENV-GREY-5KI：For the Vestisen Ice Dome Station, the hydrological filtration audit of the habitat plumbing circuit documents a greywater recycling efficiency of 80 %, representing the percentage of domestic wash water reclaimed for station reuse.
ENV-GREY-F4Y：For the Kallio Glacier Outpost, the hydrological filtration audit of the habitat plumbing circuit indicates a greywater recycling efficiency of 90 %, reflecting the percentage of domestic wash water reclaimed for reuse.
